prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a wide pedestrian walkway on a large suspension bridge with a waist-high railing, standard lamp posts and the city skyline in daylight, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, natural soft black hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a gold small flared temple bell, a bronze square-sided cowbell, a gold cube-shaped block, a copper hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three silver hair ornaments. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal hot pink leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a hot pink leather micro-bikini top reduced to two tiny opaque triangles on thin strings tied at the neck and back, each just big enough to cover only her nipple and nothing more, leaving the rest of her bust visible around them, her stomach fully visible below.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Emirati man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth warm golden-tan skin, a calm gentle gaze, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a tin pyramid-shaped lump, a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze ship's anchor, a bronze round bell, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal hair ornaments. Extra long nails in matching polished frost ice.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body frosted ice fused directly to his own form wrapping his whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid ice curving to follow his body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted ice sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING pale icy-blue frosted ice surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID white frost crystals and fine crack lines spreading through every section, glossy frosted, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. His face and ears are real living skin, and his neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and his shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved frosted ice.

RIGHT Cracks: the frosted ice body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across his left upper arm, and one chipped-off piece at his left hip, where the broken edge reveals the rough cloudy white ice with a dull frosted surface inside. Everywhere else, including his chest, the frosted ice is smooth, polished and whole, and his face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: both hands clasped behind his lower back, shoulders back, one foot crossed in front of the other.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme strappy platform stiletto sandals in red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with his legs and ankles staying solid carved frosted ice right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
